-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.TxnRange` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem mvcc.doneNil_persistent (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) : Persistent (mvcc.doneNil ctx)

def mvcc.doneNil (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      □
        ∀ Φ,
          True -∗
            ▷ (True -∗ Φ (intoVal chan.nil)) -∗
              WP ((intoVal (methods ctx.ty go!"Done" ctx.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

def mvcc.neverCd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF) :=
  { Values := GMap.empty, Deadline := none, Done_gn := { doneGn := 0, closedGn := 0 }, PDone := iprop(False) }

theorem mvcc.rangeCtx_Done (todo : Bool) (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF))
    : mvcc.rangeCtx todo ctx cd ⊢ □ ∀ Φ, True -∗ (▷ ∀ ch, mvcc.rangeDone todo cd ch -∗ Φ (intoVal
    ch)) -∗ WP ((intoVal (methods ctx.ty go!"Done" ctx.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.rangeDone (todo : Bool) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (ch : GoChan) : IProp GF :=
  if todo = true then iprop(⌜ch = chan.nil⌝ ∨ (∃ γch, context.isContextDone cd ch γch) ∗ mvcc.neverDone cd)
  else iprop(∃ γch, context.isContextDone cd ch γch)

def mvcc.TxnKind.readLog : mvcc.TxnKind → mvcc.Log :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => log
  | mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts deletes putSize => ilog ++ [pend]

theorem mvcc.doneNil_todo : ⊢ mvcc.doneNil mvcc.todoCtxV

def mvcc.TxnKind.readRev : mvcc.TxnKind → w64 :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => rev
  | mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts deletes putSize => W64 ↑(mvcc.writeRev ilog pend)

theorem mvcc.rangeCtx_persistent (todo : Bool) (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) (cd : context.ContextDesc
    (IProp GF)) : Persistent (mvcc.rangeCtx todo ctx cd)

def mvcc.rangeCtx (todo : Bool) (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) : IProp
    GF :=
  if todo = true then iprop(mvcc.doneNil ctx ∨ context.isContext ctx cd ∗ mvcc.neverDone cd) else context.isContext ctx cd

theorem mvcc.txnCtx_rangeCtx (nd : Bool) (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF))
    : mvcc.txnCtx ctx cd ⊢ (if nd = true then mvcc.neverDone cd else True) -∗ ∃ td, ⌜nd = true → td
    = true⌝ ∗ mvcc.rangeCtx td ctx cd

theorem mvcc.wp_todoCtx_Done : ⊢ ∀ Φ, True -∗ ▷ (True -∗ Φ (intoVal chan.nil)) -∗ WP ((intoVal
    (methods context.todoCtx.ty go!"Done" (intoVal (zero_val context.todoCtx)))) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ
    }}

def mvcc.txnCtx (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.doneNil ctx ∨ context.isContext ctx cd)

theorem mvcc.txnCtx_todo (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) : ⊢ mvcc.txnCtx mvcc.todoCtxV cd

theorem mvcc.neverDone_persistent (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) : Persistent (mvcc.neverDone
    cd)

theorem mvcc.ite_neverDone_persistent (nd : Bool) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) : Persistent
    (if nd = true then mvcc.neverDone cd else iprop(True))

def mvcc.neverDone (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□ (cd.PDone -∗ False))

def mvcc.TxnKind.beginRev : mvcc.TxnKind → w64 :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => rev
  | mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts deletes putSize => W64 (↑(List.length ilog) - 1)

theorem mvcc.isTxn_readRev {trace : Loc} (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (kind : mvcc.TxnKind)
    (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) : mvcc.isTxn mw s γ trace kind crev Z ⊢ mvcc.isTxn mw s γ trace kind
    crev Z ∗ ⌜0 ≤ sint.Z kind.readRev⌝

theorem mvcc.rangeDone_persistent (todo : Bool) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (ch : GoChan)
    : Persistent (mvcc.rangeDone todo cd ch)

def mvcc.TxnKind.pend : mvcc.TxnKind → List mvcc.Change :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => []
  | mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts deletes putSize => pend

theorem mvcc.neverDone_neverCd : ⊢ mvcc.neverDone mvcc.neverCd

theorem mvcc.txnCtx_persistent (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) :
    Persistent (mvcc.txnCtx ctx cd)

def mvcc.todoCtxV : GoInterfaceOk :=
  interface.mk context.todoCtx.ty (intoVal (zero_val context.todoCtx))

theorem mvcc.wp_select1_alt_or_nil (c : comm_clause) (P : IProp GF) (dflt : Expr) (Φ : val → IProp
    GF) : ⊢ (P -∗ chan.nonblockingAltClausePre c Φ iprop(P ∗ True)) ∨ chan.nilClausePre c -∗ P -∗ (P
    -∗ True -∗ WP dflt {{ Φ }}) -∗ WP (SelectStmt (SelectStmtClausesV (some dflt) [c])) {{ Φ }}
